answer: Tie each identity to a scarce hardware anchor that emits a periodic signed beacon; standing climbs toward the reward summit only when several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single root, so its endorsements only whisper back onto themselves and never span distinct clusters, leaving clones stalled far below the summit. Forging 100 heads costs 100 anchors plus 100 slow climbs, while an honest agent pays that anchor once.
